name: New building
how_it_is_assessed: The use being built is looked up in the matrix for the parcel's zone; building standards then apply.

name: Extension
how_it_is_assessed: The use is unchanged, so the matrix is not consulted; the extended building must still meet the zone's standards.

name: Alteration
how_it_is_assessed: As for an extension; the matrix applies only if the alteration changes the use.

name: Change of use
how_it_is_assessed: From the existing use group (spatial_planning.existing_use) to the proposed one; the matrix decides whether the proposed use is permitted, by special consent, or prohibited.

name: Subdivision
how_it_is_assessed: Tests the resulting parcels against the zone's minimum stand size, and the intended use against the matrix.

name: Consolidation
how_it_is_assessed: Merges parcels; tests the combined parcel against the zone's standards.

name: Rezoning
how_it_is_assessed: Asks to change the zone itself, so the matrix for the current zone does not decide it; follows the plan-amendment route.

name: Other
how_it_is_assessed: Assessed by an officer; no automatic test.
